description: C01 Part II on the existing 64-map test panel (development panel). Contrasts, thresholds and families are those of the C01 design (research document section 12.4, written 2026-10-18, before any Part II run). P3 (MDP/POMDP twin) was not run but still counts in the principal family (m = 3). The confirmatory analysis repeats this spec on the new sealed panel with best_B; this one is not confirmatory. The exploratory family, including the clock control, was added after an interim look.
